descriptor.retrieval_description: Small cylindrical paper cup with a smooth, dry lateral sidewall and continuous curvature. The intended contact region is clean and uniform, presenting no visible seams or interruptions.

descriptor.uncertainty: None regarding the visible surface material and geometry; minor uncertainty regarding exact wall thickness from the top-down perspective.
